justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/FileWriterWithEncoding.java:84-156 and src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/build/AbstractStreamBuilder.java:47-120. The nested Builder is very small: it keeps only two fields (`append`, `charsetEncoder`) and exposes only a trivial constructor, two setters, and two tiny helper methods plus `get()`. Its logic is cohesive around assembling file/encoding/append inputs, while the real writer setup and cleanup live in the outer class’s `initWriter(...)` method and shared builder behavior comes from `AbstractStreamBuilder`. There is no evidence of excessive size or multiple separable responsibilities.
